basis_labels.written: 2026-08-27, additive, answering note 2 and note 3 of GSSCanada/GSSCanada-main/4J_docs_occ/messages_OpenUBEM/2026-08-27_4J_to_OpenUBEM_reply_S3_basis_population_closeout.md
basis_labels.pooled_heating_only_intensity_kwh_m2: HEATING-ONLY. Annual sum of the hourly Zone Ideal Loads Zone Total Heating Energy Output:Variable. Never quote as a whole-building EUI.
basis_labels.pooled_total_site_intensity_kwh_m2: TWO-END-USE MODEL TOTAL, not a whole-building EUI. The S3 models contain exactly two end uses: ideal-loads heating and a constant OtherEquipment electricity gain. People 0, Lights 0, ElectricEquipment 0, WaterUse* 0, cooling coils 0. No TABULA comparison, no measured-national-EUI comparison and no N1 projection is reachable from 93.768 either.
basis_labels.total_to_heating_ratio: Ratio between the two end uses of the model, not a heating fraction of a real building.
basis_labels.rows_compared: PER-ZONE-HOUR, not per-hour: 8760 x zone_count. Eight distinct values, 8760 to 70080; zone total 374 over the accepted 95.
basis_labels.gain_csv_count_381: 381 is the ALL-96 zone total (gain CSVs are inputs and exist for the fatal building too). The ACCEPTED-95 zone population is 374; the extra 7 are the zones of BATIMENT0000000240879534_part0. Never quote 381 as an accepted-campaign population.
